snippet.title: Run Quad Run - Release Trailer | Coming January 8, 2026 🏁📦
snippet.description:
🏁 WISHLIST Run Quad Run! Coming to Steam on January 8, 2026
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3733970/Run_Quad_Run/

Run Quad Run is a top-down skill based parkour game where you escape from the evil shapes to recover the lost artifacts of Cubicland. Navigate through various worlds with different enemies and master your reflex skills in the world of cubes 📦

If you're new here, welcome to my channel. I am a Solo Game Developer and a Pixel Artist working on Run Quad Run. It is a top-down skill based parkour game and my very first game project to be released on Steam. If you're interested in my art & game dev videos, don't hesitate to subscribe and leave a like & comment down below 🗨️

Check out all my links HERE: https://linktr.ee/chelafinx
Run Quad Run Trailer Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lT6kcQLZMxs
